group:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2025.overview: 加纳摄影记者宁森在纽约看到大量非洲影像，受此启发回国建起摄影书图书馆迪坎中心，让加纳人了解自己的历史；文章还回顾了他走上摄影之路的经历和参观者的感受。
group:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2025.fullTranslationZh:
加纳摄影记者保罗·宁森感到很吃惊。五年前他来纽约学习摄影时，发现这座城市的图书馆和博物馆里收藏着大量反映非洲生活的图像。身在离加纳几千英里外的地方，他身边的非洲影像历史竟比他在家乡见过的还要多。
这激励他在加纳建一座摄影书图书馆，把非洲的故事带回家乡，让人们了解自己的历史，也给他们讲述这片大陆新故事的工具。随着迪坎中心在加纳首都阿克拉建成，这个想法实现了。“迪坎”在阿坎语里的意思是“带头”。
这并不是宁森唯一一次把目标对准一个看似不可能实现的梦想。在加纳，摄影并不算一条受重视的职业道路。宁森说：“如果你告诉父母你要当摄影师，他们的反应就像是：‘什么？去当律师吧。’”但宁森觉得摄影就是他的使命。他深受祖父母代代相传的家族讲故事传统的影响，后来又被一位朋友拍的照片吸引，爱上了摄影。把两者结合起来对他来说再自然不过，于是他全身心投入其中。凭着极大的决心，他收集了三万多册书。2022年12月，迪坎中心开放了。
加纳人丹妮拉·阿弗尔被迪坎的展览深深打动，她说展览让她对自己国家的过去和现在有了新的看法。她说：“迪坎让艺术和摄影变得更有意义。它让我们看到了希望：也许不久后加纳就会有一座音乐图书馆。我们还可以在加纳建电影图书馆——什么都行，只要能保存我们的历史、创造历史。”

selectedLongSentences.displayText: That inspired him to create a library of photobooks in Ghana to bring the African story home, allowing people to learn about their history and giving them tools to tell new stories of the continent.

selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 That inspired him to create a library of photobooks（这激励他建一座摄影书图书馆），用的是 inspire sb to do 结构，That 指他在纽约看到大量非洲图像这件事。in Ghana 说明建在哪里，to bring the African story home 说明建馆的目的；句末 allowing… 和 giving… 是两个并列的现在分词短语，说明建馆带来的结果：让人们了解历史，给他们讲新故事的工具。

underlineRanges.quote: to bring the African story home

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: He was deeply influenced by the rich family history of storytelling passed down through his grandparents and later, attracted by a friend’s images, developed a love of photography.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: He was deeply influenced by the rich family history of storytelling passed down through his grandparents and later, attracted by a friend’s images, developed a love of photography.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 他深受祖父母代代相传的家族讲故事传统的影响，后来又被一位朋友拍的照片吸引，爱上了摄影。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主语 He 带两个由 and 连接的谓语：was deeply influenced by…（深受……影响）和 later developed a love of photography（后来爱上了摄影）。passed down through his grandparents 是过去分词短语，修饰前面讲故事的家族传统，说明它是祖父母传下来的；attracted by a friend’s images 插在 later 和 developed 之间，交代他爱上摄影的起因。两个谓语正好对应家人和朋友两方面的影响。

paragraphs.function: 以宁森的意外发现开篇，引出他建馆的起因。

paragraphs.function: 交代建馆的目的和结果。

paragraphs.summary: 摄影在加纳不受重视，但宁森受家族讲故事传统和朋友照片的影响爱上摄影，收集了三万多册书，迪坎中心于2022年12月开放。

paragraphs.function: 借参观者的评价说明迪坎中心的意义。

question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.questionFocus: 找出宁森在纽约看到了什么而感到吃惊。
question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.stemTranslationZh: 在纽约，什么让保罗·宁森感到吃惊？

evidence.quote: he found a large collection of images of life in Africa in the city’s libraries and museums
evidence.anchor: 馆藏大量非洲生活图像

trap.relationNote: 选项借 visual history（影像历史）拼出“历史摄影展”；原文说的是图书馆和博物馆里收藏的大量非洲图像，没提他看了什么摄影展。

trapEvidence.quote: surrounded by more visual history of Africa than he had ever seen back home

trap.sourceQuote: a large collection of images of life in Africa
trap.explanation: 让他吃惊的是图像（images），内容是整个非洲的生活；选项改成了视频，又把范围缩到加纳一国。

trapEvidence.quote: a large collection of images of life in Africa

trap.relationNote: photography 出自[[block:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2025-m1:reading-b:1|to study photography five years ago]]，说的是他来纽约是为了学摄影；让他吃惊的是馆藏的非洲图像，不是培训课程。

trapEvidence.quote: When he came to New York to study photography five years ago

locationParaphrases.targetText: When he came to New York to study photography five years ago, he found a large collection of images of life in Africa in the city’s libraries and museums.
locationParaphrases.answerText: a large collection of images of life in Africa
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 New York 原词出现在原文。

locationParaphrases.targetText: a large collection of images of life in Africa
locationParaphrases.note: 选项的“许多图片”（Many pictures）就是原文的“大量图像”（a large collection of images），“关于非洲”对应“非洲的生活”（life in Africa），选 A。

question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.questionFocus: 找出宁森在加纳建迪坎中心想达到什么目的。
question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.stemTranslationZh: 宁森为什么在加纳创建迪坎中心？
question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.locateFindZh: 看 to bring 后面说的目的

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了在全球传播非洲文化。

trap.sourceQuote: to bring the African story home
trap.explanation: 原文是把非洲的故事带回家乡（bring … home），让加纳人自己看到；选项说向全世界传播，方向正好反了。

trapEvidence.quote: to bring the African story home

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了改善人们的生活条件。

trap.claim: 建中心是为了改善人们的生活条件
trap.explanation: 原文说建馆是让人们了解历史、给他们讲新故事的工具，没提改善生活条件。

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了让非洲人了解自己的根。

evidence.quote: to bring the African story home, allowing people to learn about their history
evidence.anchor: 让人们了解自己的历史

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 为了发展加纳的摄影书市场。

trap.relationNote: 选项借 photobook 编出“摄影书市场”；原文的 photobooks 是图书馆里供人阅读的藏书，他收集书是为了让人了解历史，没提做生意。

trapEvidence.quote: to create a library of photobooks in Ghana

locationParaphrases.targetText: That inspired him to create a library of photobooks in Ghana to bring the African story home, allowing people to learn about their history and giving them tools to tell new stories of the continent.
locationParaphrases.answerText: bring the African story home, allowing people to learn about their history
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 create the Dikan Center 对应原文 create a library of photobooks，迪坎中心就是这座图书馆。

locationParaphrases.sourceText: offer Africans insights into their roots
locationParaphrases.targetText: allowing people to learn about their history
locationParaphrases.note: 选项的“了解自己的根”（insights into their roots）就是原文的“了解自己的历史”（learn about their history）；这里的“人们”（people）就是故事被带回家乡后看到它的加纳人，所以选项说“非洲人”，选 C。

question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.questionFocus: 找出宁森用照片讲故事的原因。
question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.stemTranslationZh: 宁森为什么选择用照片讲故事？

trap.sourceQuote: Photography isn’t exactly valued as a career path in Ghana.
trap.optionText: It was quite popular in Ghana.
trap.explanation: 原文说在加纳摄影并不被看作好的职业（isn’t exactly valued），选项却说很受欢迎，正好相反。

trapEvidence.quote: Photography isn’t exactly valued as a career path in Ghana.

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 他的父母鼓励他这样做。

trap.sourceQuote: If you tell your parents you’re going to be a photographer, it was like, ‘What? Go be a lawyer.’
trap.optionText: His parents encouraged him to do so.
trap.explanation: 宁森说父母一听孩子要当摄影师，就会让他去当律师（Go be a lawyer），这是劝阻，不是鼓励。

trapEvidence.quote: If you tell your parents you’re going to be a photographer, it was like, ‘What? Go be a lawyer.’

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 他受到了家人和朋友的影响。

evidence.quote: He was deeply influenced by the rich family history of storytelling passed down through his grandparents and later, attracted by a friend’s images, developed a love of photography.
evidence.anchor: 受家族传统和朋友照片影响

trap.relationNote: 选项照搬[[block:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2025-m1:reading-b:1]]的 study photography（学摄影），那只是他来纽约的目的；他为什么选摄影，原文在[[block:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2025-m1:reading-b:3]]讲的是家里讲故事的传统和朋友的照片。

trapEvidence.quote: When he came to New York to study photography five years ago

locationParaphrases.targetText: He was deeply influenced by the rich family history of storytelling passed down through his grandparents and later, attracted by a friend’s images, developed a love of photography.
locationParaphrases.answerText: deeply influenced by the rich family history of storytelling passed down through his grandparents and later, attracted by a friend’s images
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 tell stories 对应原文 storytelling，同句还有 photography 对应 photographs。

locationParaphrases.sourceText: influenced by his family and friend
locationParaphrases.targetText: deeply influenced by the rich family history of storytelling
locationParaphrases.note: 选项把两处影响合在一起：“家人”指祖父母传下来的讲故事传统（family history of storytelling），“朋友”指吸引他的朋友的照片（a friend’s images），选 C。

question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.questionFocus: 从阿弗尔看展后的反应和她说的话，判断她对展览的评价。
question:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2.stemTranslationZh: 丹妮拉·阿弗尔认为迪坎的展览怎么样？

trap.explanation: 她只说展览打动了她、让她有了新看法，没说展览难懂或给她出了难题。
她看重的是迪坎让艺术和摄影更有意义（more significant）、能保存历史，没说展览好玩。

trap.sourceQuote: Ghanaian photojournalist Paul Ninson was surprised.
trap.explanation: 文中感到吃惊（surprised）的是[[block:paper-mock-hebei-shijiazhuang-2025-m1:reading-b:1]]里在纽约看到大量非洲图像的宁森；阿弗尔对展览是被打动（moved），还得到了新看法。

trapEvidence.quote: Ghanaian photojournalist Paul Ninson was surprised.

evidence.quote: particularly moved by Dikan’s exhibition, and said it gave her a new viewpoint
It has given us the hope that we may soon have a music library in Ghana.

locationParaphrases.targetText: Ghanaian Daniella Afful was particularly moved by Dikan’s exhibition, and said it gave her a new viewpoint
locationParaphrases.answerText: particularly moved by Dikan’s exhibition, and said it gave her a new viewpoint
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 Daniella Afful 原词出现在原文。
原文没直接用 inspiring，而是写她被展览深深打动（particularly moved），展览给了她看国家的新视角（a new viewpoint），她接着又说迪坎带来了希望（given us the hope）；能打动人、给人新想法和希望，就是选项说的“鼓舞人心”，选 D。
